welcome.title: Welcome to Cairn
welcome.description: Cairn is a local-first coding agent. Take a minute to learn where your data, keys and network requests go.
welcome.noAccount.title: No account and no telemetry
welcome.noAccount.body: Cairn never asks you to sign in and does not collect usage data on first run or in the background.
welcome.purpose.title: Works inside your projects
welcome.purpose.body: Cairn reads and writes the project folders you choose and asks for approval before commands or file edits according to your permission rules. Commands run in a restricted workspace sandbox by default.
welcome.data.title: Data stays on this computer
welcome.data.body: Projects, sessions, settings and logs live in the local app data folder; on Windows this defaults to %APPDATA%\Cairn (Cairn-dev for development builds). Uninstalling does not delete this data.
welcome.credentials.title: API keys stay on this computer
welcome.credentials.body: API keys are encrypted by the operating system's credential protection and never uploaded to Cairn. Model requests send the context you choose to the model provider you configured.
welcome.update.title: Update checks and diagnostics
welcome.update.body: Update checks contact only a public, read-only update source and send no project content or credentials. Diagnostics bundles are created only when you export them, contain redacted settings and logs, and are never uploaded automatically.
welcome.limits.title: Know the security boundaries
welcome.limits.body: The command sandbox is not a virtual machine. Unsigned beta installers may trigger Windows SmartScreen; install only from a source you trust.
welcome.noProvider: No model provider is configured yet. You can browse existing data first and configure one in Settings at any time.
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: For Cairn 0.1.0 beta. Cairn is a local-first application with no accounts, cloud sync or telemetry.
privacy.noAccount.title: Accounts and telemetry
privacy.noAccount.body: No registration or sign-in is required. Cairn does not collect usage statistics, crash reports or device identifiers, and never uploads content automatically in the background.
privacy.data.title: Local data
privacy.data.body: Project records, sessions, settings, checkpoints, logs and installed skills live in the local app data folder. The default is %APPDATA%\Cairn. Uninstalling keeps this data unless you remove it manually.
privacy.models.title: Model requests
privacy.models.body: When you send a message or run a task, the selected context is sent to the model provider you configured. That provider handles the content under its own privacy policy, which Cairn cannot control.
privacy.credentials.title: API keys and credentials
privacy.credentials.body: API keys and MCP tokens are encrypted by the operating system's credential protection and stored locally. They are not written to project files, logs, diagnostics bundles or update metadata, and are never uploaded to Cairn.
privacy.updates.title: Update checks
privacy.updates.body: Update checks contact only a public, read-only static update source to download version information and installers. Requests contain no project content, sessions, settings or credentials.
privacy.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics bundles
privacy.diagnostics.body: Diagnostics bundles are created only when you export them and contain system information plus redacted settings and logs. Session message bodies are excluded by default and require an explicit opt-in. Bundles are never uploaded automatically.
privacy.integrations.title: Skills and MCP
privacy.integrations.body: Skill marketplace searches and MCP connections contact the services you choose. Those requests are governed by the relevant service's privacy policy. Installed skills and MCP configuration stay on this computer.
privacy.retention.title: Retention and deletion
privacy.retention.body: Uninstalling Cairn does not remove user data. To delete everything, quit the app first and then remove the app data folder manually; export or back up anything you want to keep before doing so.
privacy.changes.title: Changes to this notice
privacy.changes.body: This is an engineering draft for the beta and still requires review by the project owner and legal counsel before a stable release. Updates will ship with new versions and remain available in the app.
gpl.title: GPL source code
gpl.description: The bundled MinGit (Git for Windows) is distributed under GPL-2.0-only.
gpl.body: Cairn distributes an unmodified subset of MinGit as a separate program and does not link it into Cairn code. The corresponding source is available from the same Git for Windows release tag.
gpl.license: The full GPLv2 text ships with the third-party notices and is also available in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt in the install directory.
